title: Slow Motion Steam Clock in the Snow
author: sjrankin
why: The Otaru steam clock standing at the entrance of the Otaru Orgel-dō (Music Box Museum) Main Hall, brick facade behind, snow falling — the museum's landmark + winter. Pre-cropped from a 576x1024 portrait (video still) to a 16:10 band on the clock face, so only 576x360: soft. No CC photo of the music-box displays themselves in the feed; alternative = MIKI Yoshihito 'The Otaru Orgel Doh Main Hall.' (CC BY 2.0, flickr.com/photos/mujitra/54238115307, crystal figurines inside, Dec 2024).
